blogPosts.title: Signs Your Split System Needs Servicing in Bellarine
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn the key indicators that your split system air conditioner requires professional servicing in the Bellarine Peninsula.
body: Recognizing the signs that your split system needs servicing in Bellarine is essential to maintain efficiency and prevent costly repairs. Common indicators include reduced cooling or heating performance, strange noises during operation, and unusual odors from the vents. In Bellarine's coastal climate, where salt air can accelerate wear, regular servicing helps keep your system running smoothly.

If your split system is taking longer to reach the desired temperature or if certain rooms feel warmer than others, it might be due to dirty filters or refrigerant leaks. Bellarine homes often face dust and pollen buildup, especially in spring and summer, which clogs filters and reduces airflow. A professional service from Lewis & Co Plumbing includes cleaning or replacing filters, checking refrigerant levels, and ensuring optimal performance for Bellarine's weather conditions.

Another sign is increased energy bills without a change in usage; this often points to an inefficient system that needs maintenance. In Bellarine, where summers can be hot and humid, a well-serviced split system operates more efficiently, saving you money on electricity. We recommend scheduling servicing at least once a year to catch issues early and extend the lifespan of your unit.

Strange sounds like grinding, squealing, or rattling can indicate mechanical problems, such as loose parts or failing components. In Bellarine's quiet residential areas, these noises can be disruptive and signal underlying issues that require immediate attention. Our technicians diagnose and fix these problems, ensuring your system runs quietly and reliably.

Poor air quality or musty smells from the split system may suggest mould or mildew growth, which is common in Bellarine's humid environment. Regular servicing includes cleaning the coils and drainage system to prevent health hazards and maintain indoor air quality. We focus on thorough maintenance to keep your Bellarine home comfortable and safe.

Additionally, if your split system is over 10 years old or hasn't been serviced in a while, it's wise to have it checked by a professional. In Bellarine, where climate control is crucial for comfort, proactive servicing can prevent unexpected breakdowns during peak seasons. Lewis & Co Plumbing offers comprehensive split system servicing tailored to Bellarine's needs, ensuring your system remains in top condition.

blogPosts.title: How to Maintain Your Plumbing in Belmont During Winter
blogPosts.excerpt: Essential tips for Belmont homeowners to protect their plumbing systems from winter challenges and prevent common issues.
body: Maintaining your plumbing in Belmont during winter is crucial to avoid freezes, bursts, and other cold-weather problems. Belmont's cool temperatures, especially overnight, can cause pipes to contract and crack, so insulating exposed pipes is a key preventive measure. We recommend using foam insulation sleeves or heat tape on pipes in unheated areas like garages or crawl spaces.

Another important step is to check for leaks before the cold sets in; even a small drip can turn into a major issue when temperatures drop. In Belmont, where older homes may have aging pipes, regular inspections by a licensed plumber can identify weak spots. At Lewis & Co Plumbing, we offer pre-winter plumbing checks to ensure your Belmont home is prepared.

Keeping your home heated, even at a low temperature, helps prevent pipes from freezing. Belmont residents should set thermostats to at least 13°C when away and open cabinet doors under sinks to allow warm air circulation. These simple steps can save you from costly emergency repairs during winter.

Additionally, know where your main water shut-off valve is located in case of a burst pipe. In Belmont, rapid response is essential to minimize water damage. We advise homeowners to label the valve clearly and test it periodically to ensure it works when needed.

Outdoor taps and hoses should be disconnected and drained before winter to prevent freezing and bursting. Belmont's frosty mornings can damage exterior plumbing, so taking these precautions extends the life of your fixtures. Our team can assist with winterizing your outdoor plumbing to keep it safe.

Finally, be mindful of what goes down your drains; winter often leads to more cooking and heating, increasing the risk of clogs. Using drain strainers and avoiding pouring grease down the sink can prevent blockages. In Belmont, where households are busy during the holidays, these habits help maintain smooth plumbing operation. Lewis & Co Plumbing is here to help with any winter plumbing needs in Belmont, ensuring your system stays reliable throughout the season.
